scope: Five short practical bilingual weapon steps, bow to bridge. Counts and S-size grades come from the actual official statistic graphic. Clip observations are separate from official text; no guessed ammunition, damage or range.

sizeTerminology.zh: S8、S10、S12 是游戏中的规格等级，不是已公开的毫米口径。
sizeTerminology.en: S8, S10 and S12 are game size grades, not verified millimetre calibres.

verifiedAutomaticChapter.label: Weaponry and loadout
verifiedAutomaticChapter.scope: Automatic chapter metadata only, not a verified specific spoken claim.

copy.zh: 舰艏的 12 个发射器构成一套 S12 光束武器，由驾驶员控制。
copy.en: Twelve bow emitters form one pilot-controlled S12 beam weapon.

steps.motionNote: Static emitter-array inspection; do not invent a turret deployment.

officialVideoEvidence.observed: Bow emitter array firing forward; layout evidence, not a damage or range measurement.

copy.zh: 2 座三联装主炮，每座配 3 门 S12 武器。收起后，炮塔由舰体外侧的装甲覆盖。
copy.en: Two main turrets carry three S12 weapons each. Hull armor covers the turrets when stowed.

steps.motionNote: Only the targeted main-battery group should deploy.

officialVideoEvidence.observed: Three barrels and a deployed turret above an open armor bay.

copy.zh: 11 座单联装 S10 副炮：3 座有人炮塔，8 座遥控炮塔。每座配 1 门 S10 武器。
copy.en: Eleven single S10 turrets comprise three manned and eight remote mounts. Each carries one S10 weapon.

steps.motionNote: Do not label a particular inspected mount as manned or remote unless its individual identity is verified.
steps.videoNote: No independent single-S10 clip exists among the four local official loops. Use the real-time model and official statistics, without an invented SCL timestamp.

copy.zh: 8 座双联装炮塔，每座配 2 门 S8 武器。船壳盖板在收起后覆盖炮位。
copy.en: Eight manned twin turrets carry two S8 weapons each. Hull covers close over the stowed mounts.

steps.motionNote: Model Defense_ group, not the PDC_ quad group.

officialVideoEvidence.observed: Rows of large mounts deploy from rectangular hull covers, matching the model Defense_ twin-turret assembly.
officialVideoEvidence.identificationBasis: Visual correspondence to the twin-turret structure; S8 and mount count come from the official statistic graphic. The clip filename does not establish caliber or category.
officialVideoEvidence.classificationConfidence: Visual match, not a text label embedded in the video.

copy.zh: 舰桥两侧共布置 2 座四联装炮塔。每座由乘员操作，配 4 门 S8 武器。
copy.en: Two quad turrets sit beside the bridge. Each manned mount carries four S8 weapons.

steps.motionNote: Model PDC_ group; this runtime prefix is not an official point-defense designation.

officialVideoEvidence.observed: Four barrels and their support assembly extend beside the bridge.

additionalOfficialCategoriesNotInFiveSte.note: Separate from S8 twin mounts and the runtime PDC_ quad group. The local filename pdc.mp4 is not proof of S2 point defense.
No deployment or launch mechanics are inferred from this count.

officialTurretTotal.calculation: 2 triple + 3 manned single + 8 remote single + 8 twin + 2 quad = 23

correctionsToPriorMediaResearch.reason: The earlier label followed the production filename. The pictured rectangular covers and large turret assembly match the Defense_ twin group. The 42 S2 point-defense specification is a separate entry.

limitations: The statistic graphic does not assign ammunition type, individual names, damage or range.
The bow beam is one system with twelve emitters, not twelve independent S12 weapons.
Only the automatic 01:44.159 weaponry chapter entrance is verified for SCL, not any specific developer quote.
Video names and model node prefixes are production labels, not reliable official classifications.
